questions.q: How heavy is the FIFA World Cup trophy, in kilograms?
questions.how: It is 18-carat gold but only 36.8 centimetres tall.

questions.q: How many goals were scored in the 2023-24 Premier League season?
FIFA's Big Count in 2006 put the number of people who play football worldwide at how many?
questions.how: About four in every hundred people on Earth at the time.

questions.q: Shane Long scored for Southampton at Watford in April 2019 with the match barely started. How many seconds after kick-off?
questions.how: He charged down Craig Cathcart's clearance and chipped Ben Foster.

questions.q: How many matches were played at the men's World Cups from 1930 to 2022, 22 tournaments in all?
questions.how: The first had 18 matches. From 1998 to 2022 each had 64.

questions.q: According to Deloitte, how much did Premier League clubs spend in gross transfer fees in the summer 2023 window?
questions.how: Twenty clubs averaging about 118 million pounds each.

questions.q: Newport County goalkeeper Tom King scored straight from a goal kick in January 2021. How far did the ball travel, in metres?
questions.how: Almost the whole length of the pitch, with the wind behind it.

questions.q: How many matches did Sir Alex Ferguson manage Manchester United in all competitions?
questions.how: Twenty-six and a half seasons at fifty to sixty games each.

questions.q: How many people in total attended matches at the 1994 World Cup in the USA?
As of November 2026, how many member associations does FIFA have?
questions.how: More than the United Nations, which has 193 member states.

questions.q: How many minutes did Edwin van der Sar go without conceding a Premier League goal in 2008-09?
questions.how: Fourteen clean sheets in a row is 1,260 minutes before you add the rest.

questions.q: How many people watched Barcelona v Wolfsburg in the Women's Champions League at Camp Nou in April 2022?
questions.how: A few weeks earlier, 91,553 had come to the same ground for the Real Madrid game.

questions.q: What is the most a match football may weigh at kick-off, in grams?
questions.how: The Laws of the Game allow 410 to 450 grams.

questions.q: How many goals were scored at the men's World Cups from 1930 to 2022, 22 tournaments in all?
According to FIFA, what was the combined global audience for the 2018 World Cup final?
questions.how: FIFA put the audience for the whole tournament at about 3.57 billion.
